behavior.pattern: A trigger opens a floating panel holding ARBITRARY consumer content (contrast dropdown-menu's fixed action-item list and tooltip's non-interactive text-only bubble — see POPOVER-MATRIX.md §0 for the three-way distinction). Click opens (not hover, unlike tooltip). The panel MAY compose an optional header (title + description + actions), an optional dedicated scrollable content wrapper, an optional close button, and an optional arrow — all real, sourced, and asymmetric across systems (see structure rows). The SHARPEST behavioural finding this component produced: Salt's real Overlay is NOT a lightweight non-modal popup the way shadcn's canonical (non-modal-by-default) Popover is — it renders `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"", and passes `outsideElementsInert: true` to floating-ui's own `FloatingFocusManager`, whose own default `modal` option is `true` — meaning Salt's Overlay TRAPS focus and inerts the rest of the page exactly like a non-full-screen dialog, while shadcn's Popover (Radix's own documented `modal` default `false`) lets focus and pointer interaction continue reaching the rest of the page while the popover is open. Modelled as `behavior.modal-focus-trap`, a real, config-gated structural divergence, not a style deviation.
behavior.chassis: skeleton/popover.tsx — written from the template's part union; inherits from no design system. The trigger CLONES the consumer's child element (`React.cloneElement`, the SAME technique tooltip.tsx already uses and the one Salt's real `OverlayTrigger` itself performs via `cloneElement`/`getRefFromChildren`) rather than rendering a bare new `<button>` the way dropdown-menu.tsx does — popover's trigger is consumer-supplied content (usually a Button), not a chassis-owned element. POSITIONING is the same DECLARED GAP tooltip.tsx already carries (see behavior.positioning-engine): a `getBoundingClientRect()` placement calculation with a fixed offset, no flip/shift/collision detection, in place of Salt's real `@floating-ui/react` middleware stack or shadcn's real (external, unvendored) Radix Popper primitive. DISMISS-OUTSIDE is a real document-level pointerdown listener, the SAME proven pattern dropdown-menu.tsx/select.tsx already carry (their own declared floating-position-engine gap note applies identically here).
